description: JST B2B-XH-A(LF)(SN) — 2-pin XH-series wire-to-board shrouded header, 2.5mm pitch, through-hole, top-entry. The standard connector for 2S LiPo balance leads and generic board power input.
name: b2b-xh-a-lf-sn
watch_out_for: Mates with JST XHP-2 housing + SXH-001T-P0.6 crimp contacts (sold separately). 2.5mm pitch — not compatible with 2.54mm Dupont. Rated 250V/3A. White PA66 housing, tin-plated brass contacts.
